R133: The modeled usable capacity is 80% for LFP (20-100%), 85% for sodium-ion (15-100%), and 50% for lead-acid (50-100%). Standard voltage adjustments for LFP limit sodium-ion to about 85% of nominal capacity; their shallower depth of discharge extends cycle life.
